## Details

<a id="title_unused_8080_code"></a>
### [`title_unused_8080_code`](../../../../src/data/title_picture.asm#L6) `$5797-$57FF`

*data*

Bytes that nothing reads. They decode as 8080 code that calls the CP/M BDOS entry (CALL $0005) with the functions C = $10 to $16 (close, search first, search next, delete, read sequential, write sequential, make file).

<a id="title_colour_ram"></a>
### [`title_colour_ram`](../../../../src/data/title_picture.asm#L22) `$5800-$5BE7`

*data*

Title picture: the 1000 colour RAM bytes. The title code copies them to $d800.

- **Referred to by:** [`title_copy_colours`](../leftovers/leftover_5718.md#title_copy_colours)
